scope.selection: all 22 distinct player IDs present at each of snap_frame-3, snap_frame-2, snap_frame-1; 11 offense and 11 defense at the latest pre-snap frame
scope.feature_cutoff: strictly before ball_snap; max input frame is snap_frame-1
excluded_inputs: snap frame and all later tracking coordinates
scope.holdout_status: weeks 6-9 were previously examined; all results are development-only and not holdout-validated

method.coordinate_units: yards; positions use BDB x/y at the three strictly pre-snap frames
method.velocity: finite difference of x/y between snap_frame-2 and snap_frame-1 at 10 Hz
method.acceleration: second finite difference of x/y over snap_frame-3 through snap_frame-1 at 10 Hz
method.selection: the canonical manifest contributes only game/play identifiers, week, snap frame, possession team and defensive team; the manifest eligible_input and outcome fields are not accessed
method.row_access: only gameId, playId, nflId, frameId, club, x and y are parsed from raw tracking; rows at or after snap_frame are discarded before coordinates are read
method.aggregation: team-level means/spreads and within-/between-team distances over the full 11-player units; individual IDs are not emitted
